svg.text: In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund

g.data-flaw: A ghost of FREE ENTRY. ALL WELCOME. remains in the artwork, and the pavilion under the jar is smudged.
g.data-outlook: Probably fixable by re-converting with the current tools, which blank only the lines they reset.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. A ghost of FREE ENTRY. ALL WELCOME. remains in the artwork, and the pavilion under the jar is smudged. Probably fixable by re-converting with the current tools, which blank only the lines they reset.
